subject.title: refactor(apns): move registrations to shared SQLite

question: May a release switch APNs to SQLite-only operation when existing gateways must explicitly run `openclaw doctor --fix` before their shipped registrations are available?
rationale: The code can implement either policy, but only maintainers can accept the upgrade support burden and potential temporary loss of iOS push delivery versus requiring a visible migration gate.

options.title: Require an upgrade gate
options.body: Before merge, ensure gateways with the retired store surface a clear blocking or in-product Doctor action, and prove the complete upgrade and delivery path.

options.title: Accept explicit Doctor recovery
options.body: Ship the current behavior with maintainer-owned release communication and support expectations after live migration and delivery proof is attached.

recommendation.title: Require an upgrade gate
recommendation.body: Before merge, ensure gateways with the retired store surface a clear blocking or in-product Doctor action, and prove the complete upgrade and delivery path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked migration design and implementation and are the best available person to confirm its intended release behavior.
